Axiom: A stop is evidence, not an automatic operator pause. Classify before routing: - `RECOVERABLE_TECHNICAL`: missing rules/config/packages, malformed task structure, gate/tool diagnostics, or audit mismatch — checkpoint, bounded replan, recheck, redispatch. - `SPEC_GOAL_CONFLICT`: repair contradicts approved spec/BDD — operator product decision. - `EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED`: exact unavailable permission/authority — operator boundary. - `TECHNICAL_REPLAN_EXHAUSTED`: CLI-owned retry budget consumed — operator receives evidence.
